title: Trade review 12 Nov: 5 results, 5 lessons
summary: 1 T2 (LANDMARK +6.00%), 1 partial (URBANCO +3.68%), 2 T1 (GRANULES, SBICARD), 0 failed. CGPOWER missed winner. 82 closed now +171.6%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Thu 12 Nov:** LANDMARK closed at T2, URBANCO closed in profit, 2 trades hit T1, 1 missed winner.

A quiet day with nothing failed. Today's two closes added +9.7 points, so all 82 closed trades now total +171.6% (average +2.1%), against +162.0% from 80 last night. Nifty rose 0.18% to 25,299.35. 20 trades are still running, 12 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 102 bought trades is +1.3%. No new buys today. The next 30-day exit is MOBIKWIK (−5.9%) on 13 Nov, then TATAPOWER, CPPLUS and SBICARD (all with T1 booked) on 16 Nov.

**Today's results**
- ✅✅ **LANDMARK** (Candle at support, listed 14 Oct): T2 hit, trade closed: Bought at the zone top ₹467.67 on 15 Oct, T1 was reported on 19 Oct, sold ₹495.73 today after 28 days, +6.00%, back from a −12.33% dip. It traded 4.6% cheaper inside the entry window, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹454.05 would have made +9.18%.
- ✅ **URBANCO** (Pullback, listed 12 Oct): closed at 30 days, partial win in profit: Bought at ₹160.88 on 13 Oct, T1 was reported on 14 Oct, then it fell as far as −21.36% before recovering. Half sold at T1 ₹165.70 and half at today's close, an average exit of ₹166.80, +3.68%. It traded 4.7% cheaper inside the entry window.
- ✅ **GRANULES** (Candle at support, listed 6 Nov): T1 hit, still open: ₹800.80 → ₹829.68 in 3 days, worst dip −4.07%, now +4.96%. It traded 4.2% cheaper inside the entry window; a zone-bottom buy at ₹782.05 on 11 Nov would also be at T1 now. A strong hammer on 4.0× volume.
- ✅ **SBICARD** (Candle at support, listed 15 Oct): T1 hit, still open: ₹573.20 → ₹599.89 after 27 days, back from a −9.45% dip, now +2.93%. It traded 4.0% cheaper inside the entry window. Its 30-day exit is on 16 Nov.
- ⚪ **CGPOWER** (Candle at support, listed 6 Nov): never bought, a missed winner: It came within 1.44% of the zone top (₹771.47) but never dipped in. A buy at zone+2% (₹786.90) or at the next open (₹787.00) on 9 Nov would have reached T1 that day and since closed at T2, for +3.92% / +3.91%. Like TATAINVEST last night, it was a candle-at-support pick listed just above the zone.

Plus 57 earlier, among them PFC and TMPV (11 Nov) and DIVISLAB, KOTAKBANK and KROSS (9 Nov). These 67 wins (55 at T2, 12 partial) made +345.9%; with the 15 failures (−174.2% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%) all 82 closed trades total +171.6%. 7 of the 12 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (9): GRANULES ₹800.80 → ₹829.68 in 3 days and SBICARD ₹573.20 → ₹599.89 in 27 days (both today), LUPIN (9 Nov), CPPLUS (6 Nov), TATAPOWER (5 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 4 of these 9 are below their buy price (ASTRAL, ESCORTS, PNGSREVA, ONGC).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners now 19 of 31:** CGPOWER is new tonight, the second candle-at-support pick in two nights that listed just above the zone and ran to T2 without it. 23 of the 31 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Better prices inside the window:** All four bought trades in today's results traded 4–5% below their fill inside the entry window. Zone bottom only still fills just 45% of picks, so it is not a candidate.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, more money:** Fills 93% vs 80% as listed: 13.9 points (the bar is 15). Its 99 closed trades made +201.3%, against +171.6% from 82 as listed, with 20 losing trades against 19.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.6% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 97 closed trades made +231.0% with 15 losing trades; average closed trade +2.7% against +2.1%.
- **Near misses: the real picks now lead on both targets:** Room-filter near misses: 84 of 119 reached T1 (71%) and 61 reached T2 (51%), against 75% and 54% for the real picks. Retest near misses: 3 of 10 at T1, 1 at T2. Their money can be compared from 13 Nov.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −2.8% (closed and open), and their 22 closed trades net −64.9% with 10 of the 15 failures. The 10 retest near misses logged since the change have 1 T2 so far. Off the list since 4 Nov. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** Picks that rose 5% or more in the month before listing: 38 trades, 12 of the 15 failures, average −3.0%, 30 closed trades net −102.6%. Picks that rose less: 64 trades, 3 failures, 42 at T2 (66%), 52 closed trades made +274.3%. Third review in a row, but it is my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 37 of 41 bought reached T1 (90%) and 30 reached T2 (73%); their 32 closed trades made +173.9% with 2 failures, and they have the shallowest dip (−4.3%). All four trades that moved forward today were from this group or a pullback. (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 19 of 31 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open (CGPOWER today, TATAINVEST last night); 23 of the 31 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small, about +3.9% each. (holding)
- **(missed) The room-under-6% filter leaves winners out:** Its near misses now trail the real picks on both T1 (71% vs 75%) and T2 (51% vs 54%). If their money also trails once 30-day exits start on 13 Nov, this lesson will be dropped. (weakening)

Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (46 of 46). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 15, 53%) and those dip −9.4%. F&O stocks reach T2 more than twice as often as cash stocks (76% vs 34%) and dip far less (−3.5% vs −11.4%).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+231.0% vs +171.6%), but its dip gain is 1.2 points against a bar of 2. Zone up to 2% above gets 13.9 points more fills against a bar of 15, a little closer than last night (13.3). The run-up lesson rests on my own 5% split rather than a fixed tracker group, so it stays a lesson.

**🐞 Bug check:** nothing found. 102 bought = 55 at T2 + 12 partial + 15 failed + 20 running; T1 hit 76 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit (a partial's exit is the average of the T1 price and the 30-day close: URBANCO ₹165.70 and ₹167.90 give ₹166.80); no price revisions against last night's log and no closed row changed.
